text: {"lessons":["After selling a winner, I should not buy it back at a much higher price simply from fear of missing out; I need a clear valuation and entry plan.","My Stock C trades show how repeated buying and selling can turn uncertainty into large losses. I should set risk limits and reassess before adding to a falling or volatile position.","I should make each trade decision from current evidence and a consistent strategy, rather than reacting to short-term price moves or trying to undo a previous decision."]}
